title: HRW reports restrictive pre-election environment
detail: Human Rights Watch documented arrests, intimidation, and pressure on opposition and critics ahead of the vote, warning that these conditions were undermining credibility.

title: Voting held for 300 directly elected seats
detail: The 11th parliamentary election was held on 30 December 2018 for 300 constituency seats in the Jatiya Sangsad.

title: Official result records a landslide for the ruling alliance
detail: Reference election datasets recorded an overwhelming majority for the Awami League-led alliance; opposition leaders publicly rejected the result.

title: 2018 election becomes a democratic reference point
detail: Subsequent analysis and rights reporting repeatedly used the 2018 cycle as a reference in debates about democratic backsliding and electoral trust.
